audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Exodus / Shemot covenant ordinances text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for justice speech, enemy animal help, poor justice, sojourner love-memory, Sabbath year/week, festivals, messenger, land promise and displacement language with audit safeguards.

verses.restored: You shall not lift/carry a false report. Do not set your hand with wicked one to be violent witness.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.

modern.text: “You shall not spread a false report. Do not join the wicked by being a malicious witness.

original.text: לֹ֥א תִשָּׂ֖א שֵׁ֣מַע שָׁ֑וְא אַל תָּ֤שֶׁת יָֽדְךָ֙ עִם רָשָׁ֔ע לִהְיֹ֖ת עֵ֥ד חָמָֽס

verses.restored: You shall not follow many toward harm, and you shall not answer in dispute by bending after many to bend justice.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:

modern.text: You shall not follow the crowd in wrongdoing. When you testify in a lawsuit, do not pervert justice by siding with the crowd.

original.text: לֹֽא תִהְיֶ֥ה אַחֲרֵֽי רַבִּ֖ים לְרָעֹ֑ת וְלֹא תַעֲנֶ֣ה עַל רִ֗ב לִנְטֹ֛ת אַחֲרֵ֥י רַבִּ֖ים לְהַטֹּֽת

verses.restored: Nor shall you favor a poor one in his dispute.

familiar.text: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.

modern.text: And do not show favoritism to a poor man in his lawsuit.

original.text: וְדָ֕ל לֹ֥א תֶהְדַּ֖ר בְּרִיבֽוֹ

verses.restored: When you meet your enemy's ox or donkey wandering, returning, you shall return it to him.

familiar.text: If thou meet thine enemy’s ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.

modern.text: If you encounter your enemy’s stray ox or donkey, you must return it to him.

original.text: כִּ֣י תִפְגַּ֞ע שׁ֧וֹר אֹֽיִבְךָ֛ א֥וֹ חֲמֹר֖וֹ תֹּעֶ֑ה הָשֵׁ֥ב תְּשִׁיבֶ֖נּוּ לֽוֹ

verses.restored: When you see donkey of one hating you lying under its burden, and you would refrain from leaving it to him, releasing, you shall release it with him.

familiar.text: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.

modern.text: If you see the donkey of one who hates you fallen under its load, do not leave it there; you must help him with it.

original.text: כִּֽי תִרְאֶ֞ה חֲמ֣וֹר שֹׂנַאֲךָ֗ רֹבֵץ֙ תַּ֣חַת מַשָּׂא֔וֹ וְחָדַלְתָּ֖ מֵעֲזֹ֣ב ל֑וֹ עָזֹ֥ב תַּעֲזֹ֖ב עִמּֽוֹ

verses.restored: You shall not bend justice of your poor in his dispute.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.

modern.text: You shall not deny justice to the poor in their lawsuits.

original.text: לֹ֥א תַטֶּ֛ה מִשְׁפַּ֥ט אֶבְיֹנְךָ֖ בְּרִיבֽוֹ

verses.restored: Keep far from false matter; innocent and righteous/just do not kill, for I will not justify a wicked one.

familiar.text: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.

modern.text: Stay far away from a false accusation. Do not kill the innocent or the just, for I will not acquit the guilty.

original.text: מִדְּבַר שֶׁ֖קֶר תִּרְחָ֑ק וְנָקִ֤י וְצַדִּיק֙ אַֽל תַּהֲרֹ֔ג כִּ֥י לֹא אַצְדִּ֖יק רָשָֽׁע

verses.restored: You shall not take a bribe, for bribe blinds the seeing and twists words of righteous/just ones.

familiar.text: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.

modern.text: Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds those who see and twists the words of the righteous.

original.text: וְשֹׁ֖חַד לֹ֣א תִקָּ֑ח כִּ֤י הַשֹּׁ֨חַד֙ יְעַוֵּ֣ר פִּקְחִ֔ים וִֽיסַלֵּ֖ף דִּבְרֵ֥י צַדִּיקִֽים

verses.restored: A sojourner you shall not oppress; you yourselves know soul/life of sojourner, for you were sojourners in land of Egypt.

familiar.text: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

modern.text: Do not oppress a foreign resident, since you yourselves know how it feels to be foreigners; for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt. Sabbath Laws (Leviticus 25:1–7; Deuteronomy 15:1–6)

original.text: וְגֵ֖ר לֹ֣א תִלְחָ֑ץ וְאַתֶּ֗ם יְדַעְתֶּם֙ אֶת נֶ֣פֶשׁ הַגֵּ֔ר כִּֽי גֵרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: Six years you shall sow your land and gather its produce.

familiar.text: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the fruits thereof:

modern.text: For six years you are to sow your land and gather its produce,

original.text: וְשֵׁ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים תִּזְרַ֣ע אֶת אַרְצֶ֑ךָ וְאָסַפְתָּ֖ אֶת תְּבוּאָתָֽהּ

verses.restored: But seventh you shall let it rest and lie fallow, and poor of your people shall eat; what they leave, beast of field shall eat. Thus you shall do to your vineyard and olive grove.

familiar.text: But the seventh year thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, and with thy oliveyard.

modern.text: but in the seventh year you must let it rest and lie fallow, so that the poor among your people may eat from the field and the wild animals may consume what they leave. Do the same with your vineyard and olive grove.

original.text: וְהַשְּׁבִיעִ֞ת תִּשְׁמְטֶ֣נָּה וּנְטַשְׁתָּ֗הּ וְאָֽכְלוּ֙ אֶבְיֹנֵ֣י עַמֶּ֔ךָ וְיִתְרָ֕ם תֹּאכַ֖ל חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה כֵּֽן תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לְכַרְמְךָ֖ לְזֵיתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Six days you shall do your work, but on seventh day you shall cease, so your ox and donkey may rest, and son of your female servant and sojourner may be refreshed.

familiar.text: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.

modern.text: For six days you are to do your work, but on the seventh day you must cease, so that your ox and your donkey may rest and the son of your maidservant may be refreshed, as well as the foreign resident.

original.text: שֵׁ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה מַעֲשֶׂ֔יךָ וּבַיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י תִּשְׁבֹּ֑ת לְמַ֣עַן יָנ֗וּחַ שֽׁוֹרְךָ֙ וַחֲמֹרֶ֔ךָ וְיִנָּפֵ֥שׁ בֶּן אֲמָתְךָ֖ וְהַגֵּֽר

verses.restored: In all that I have said to you, be guarded; name of other gods you shall not mention; it shall not be heard upon your mouth.

familiar.text: And in all things that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.

modern.text: Pay close attention to everything I have said to you. You must not invoke the names of other gods; they must not be heard on your lips. The Three Feasts of Pilgrimage (Leviticus 23:1–3)

original.text: וּבְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר אָמַ֥רְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם תִּשָּׁמֵ֑רוּ וְשֵׁ֨ם אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֲחֵרִים֙ לֹ֣א תַזְכִּ֔ירוּ לֹ֥א יִשָּׁמַ֖ע עַל פִּֽיךָ

verses.restored: Three times you shall hold festival to me in the year.

familiar.text: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.

modern.text: Three times a year you are to celebrate a feast to Me.

original.text: שָׁלֹ֣שׁ רְגָלִ֔ים תָּחֹ֥ג לִ֖י בַּשָּׁנָֽה

verses.restored: Festival of Unleavened Bread you shall keep: seven days you shall eat unleavened bread as I commanded you, at appointed time in month of Aviv, for in it you came out from Egypt; none shall appear before my face empty.

familiar.text: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)

modern.text: You are to keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread as I commanded you: At the appointed time in the month of Abib you are to eat unleavened bread for seven days, because that was the month you came out of Egypt. No one may appear before Me empty-handed.

original.text: אֶת חַ֣ג הַמַּצּוֹת֮ תִּשְׁמֹר֒ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִים֩ תֹּאכַ֨ל מַצּ֜וֹת כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֗ךָ לְמוֹעֵד֙ חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽאָבִ֔יב כִּי ב֖וֹ יָצָ֣אתָ מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וְלֹא יֵרָא֥וּ פָנַ֖י רֵיקָֽם

verses.restored: And Festival of Harvest, firstfruits of your works, what you sow in field; and Festival of Ingathering at going out of year, when you gather your works from field.

familiar.text: And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, which is in the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.

modern.text: You are also to keep the Feast of Harvest with the firstfruits of the produce from what you sow in the field. And keep the Feast of Ingathering at the end of the year, when you gather your produce from the field.

original.text: וְחַ֤ג הַקָּצִיר֙ בִּכּוּרֵ֣י מַעֲשֶׂ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּזְרַ֖ע בַּשָּׂדֶ֑ה וְחַ֤ג הָֽאָסִף֙ בְּצֵ֣את הַשָּׁנָ֔ה בְּאָסְפְּךָ֥ אֶֽת מַעֲשֶׂ֖יךָ מִן הַשָּׂדֶֽה

verses.restored: Three times in year all your males shall appear before face of Lord YHWH.

familiar.text: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the LORD God.

modern.text: Three times a year all your males are to appear before the Lord GOD.

original.text: שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה יֵרָאֶה֙ כָּל זְכ֣וּרְךָ֔ אֶל פְּנֵ֖י הָאָדֹ֥ן יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: You shall not sacrifice blood/life of my sacrifice with leavened bread; fat of my festival shall not remain until morning.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.

modern.text: You must not offer the blood of My sacrifices with anything leavened, nor may the fat of My feast remain until morning.

original.text: לֹֽא תִזְבַּ֥ח עַל חָמֵ֖ץ דַּם זִבְחִ֑י וְלֹֽא יָלִ֥ין חֵֽלֶב חַגִּ֖י עַד בֹּֽקֶר

verses.restored: Beginning of firstfruits of your ground you shall bring to house of YHWH your Divine. You shall not boil a kid in milk of its mother.

familiar.text: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.

modern.text: Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the LORD your God. You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk. God’s Angel to Lead (Deuteronomy 7:12–26)

original.text: רֵאשִׁ֗ית בִּכּוּרֵי֙ אַדְמָ֣תְךָ֔ תָּבִ֕יא בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לֹֽא תְבַשֵּׁ֥ל גְּדִ֖י בַּחֲלֵ֥ב אִמּֽוֹ

verses.restored: Look, I am sending a messenger before you to guard you on the way and to bring you to place that I prepared.

familiar.text: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.

modern.text: Behold, I am sending an angel before you to protect you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared.

original.text: הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י שֹׁלֵ֤חַ מַלְאָךְ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמָרְךָ֖ בַּדָּ֑רֶךְ וְלַהֲבִ֣יאֲךָ֔ אֶל הַמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֲכִנֹֽתִי

verses.restored: Guard yourself before him and listen to his voice; do not rebel against him, for he will not carry your transgression, for my name is in him.

familiar.text: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.

modern.text: Pay attention to him and listen to his voice; do not defy him, for he will not forgive rebellion, since My Name is in him.

original.text: הִשָּׁ֧מֶר מִפָּנָ֛יו וּשְׁמַ֥ע בְּקֹל֖וֹ אַל תַּמֵּ֣ר בּ֑וֹ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יִשָּׂא֙ לְפִשְׁעֲכֶ֔ם כִּ֥י שְׁמִ֖י בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ

verses.restored: But if listening, you listen to his voice and do all that I speak, then I will be enemy to your enemies and adversary to your adversaries.

familiar.text: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.

modern.text: But if you will listen carefully to his voice and do everything I say, I will be an enemy to your enemies and a foe to your foes.

original.text: כִּ֣י אִם שָׁמֹ֤עַ תִּשְׁמַע֙ בְּקֹל֔וֹ וְעָשִׂ֕יתָ כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וְאָֽיַבְתִּי֙ אֶת אֹ֣יְבֶ֔יךָ וְצַרְתִּ֖י אֶת צֹרְרֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: For my messenger will go before you and bring you to Amorite, Hittite, Perizzite, Canaanite, Hivite, and Jebusite; and I will cut them off.

familiar.text: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.

modern.text: For My angel will go before you and bring you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I will annihilate them.

original.text: כִּֽי יֵלֵ֣ךְ מַלְאָכִי֮ לְפָנֶיךָ֒ וֶהֱבִֽיאֲךָ֗ אֶל הָֽאֱמֹרִי֙ וְהַ֣חִתִּ֔י וְהַפְּרִזִּי֙ וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י הַחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִ֑י וְהִכְחַדְתִּֽיו

verses.restored: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do according to their works; but tearing down, you shall tear them down, and shattering, you shall shatter their standing stones.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.

modern.text: You must not bow down to their gods or serve them or follow their practices. Instead, you are to demolish them and smash their sacred stones to pieces.

original.text: לֹֽא תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֤ה לֵאלֹֽהֵיהֶם֙ וְלֹ֣א תָֽעָבְדֵ֔ם וְלֹ֥א תַעֲשֶׂ֖ה כְּמַֽעֲשֵׂיהֶ֑ם כִּ֤י הָרֵס֙ תְּהָ֣רְסֵ֔ם וְשַׁבֵּ֥ר תְּשַׁבֵּ֖ר מַצֵּבֹתֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: You shall serve/worship YHWH your Divine, and he will bless your bread and your water; and I will turn aside sickness from your midst.

familiar.text: And ye shall serve the LORD your God, and he shall bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.

modern.text: So you shall serve the LORD your God, and He will bless your bread and your water. And I will take away sickness from among you.

original.text: וַעֲבַדְתֶּ֗ם אֵ֚ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם וּבֵרַ֥ךְ אֶֽת לַחְמְךָ֖ וְאֶת מֵימֶ֑יךָ וַהֲסִרֹתִ֥י מַחֲלָ֖ה מִקִּרְבֶּֽךָ

verses.restored: There shall not be one miscarrying or barren in your land; number of your days I will fill.

familiar.text: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.

modern.text: No woman in your land will miscarry or be barren; I will fulfill the number of your days.

original.text: לֹ֥א תִהְיֶ֛ה מְשַׁכֵּלָ֥ה וַעֲקָרָ֖ה בְּאַרְצֶ֑ךָ אֶת מִסְפַּ֥ר יָמֶ֖יךָ אֲמַלֵּֽא

verses.restored: My terror I will send before you, and I will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will give all your enemies to you as turned neck.

familiar.text: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.

modern.text: I will send My terror ahead of you and throw into confusion every nation you encounter. I will make all your enemies turn and run.

original.text: אֶת אֵֽימָתִי֙ אֲשַׁלַּ֣ח לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְהַמֹּתִי֙ אֶת כָּל הָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּבֹ֖א בָּהֶ֑ם וְנָתַתִּ֧י אֶת כָּל אֹיְבֶ֛יךָ אֵלֶ֖יךָ עֹֽרֶף

verses.restored: I will send hornet before you, and it will drive out Hivite, Canaanite, and Hittite from before you.

familiar.text: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.

modern.text: I will send the hornet before you to drive the Hivites and Canaanites and Hittites out of your way.

original.text: וְשָׁלַחְתִּ֥י אֶת הַצִּרְעָ֖ה לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וְגֵרְשָׁ֗ה אֶת הַחִוִּ֧י אֶת הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֛י וְאֶת הַחִתִּ֖י מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate and beast of field multiply against you.

familiar.text: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.

modern.text: I will not drive them out before you in a single year; otherwise the land would become desolate and wild animals would multiply against you.

original.text: לֹ֧א אֲגָרְשֶׁ֛נּוּ מִפָּנֶ֖יךָ בְּשָׁנָ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת פֶּן תִּהְיֶ֤ה הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ שְׁמָמָ֔ה וְרַבָּ֥ה עָלֶ֖יךָ חַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶֽה

verses.restored: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you are fruitful and inherit the land.

familiar.text: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.

modern.text: Little by little I will drive them out ahead of you, until you become fruitful and possess the land.

original.text: מְעַ֥ט מְעַ֛ט אֲגָרְשֶׁ֖נּוּ מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ עַ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּפְרֶ֔ה וְנָחַלְתָּ֖ אֶת הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: I will set your border from Sea of Reeds to Sea of Philistines, and from wilderness to River; for I will give inhabitants of land into your hand, and you shall drive them out from before you.

familiar.text: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert unto the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.

modern.text: And I will establish your borders from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines, and from the desert to the Euphrates. For I will deliver the inhabitants into your hand, and you will drive them out before you.

original.text: וְשַׁתִּ֣י אֶת גְּבֻלְךָ֗ מִיַּם סוּף֙ וְעַד יָ֣ם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וּמִמִּדְבָּ֖ר עַד הַנָּהָ֑ר כִּ֣י אֶתֵּ֣ן בְּיֶדְכֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וְגֵרַשְׁתָּ֖מוֹ מִפָּנֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: You shall not cut covenant with them or with their gods.

familiar.text: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

modern.text: You shall make no covenant with them or with their gods.

original.text: לֹֽא תִכְרֹ֥ת לָהֶ֛ם וְלֵאלֹֽהֵיהֶ֖ם בְּרִֽית

verses.restored: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin/misalign against me; for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.

familiar.text: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee sin against me: for if thou serve their gods, it will surely be a snare unto thee.

modern.text: They must not remain in your land, lest they cause you to sin against Me. For if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”

original.text: לֹ֤א יֵשְׁבוּ֙ בְּאַרְצְךָ֔ פֶּן יַחֲטִ֥יאוּ אֹתְךָ֖ לִ֑י כִּ֤י תַעֲבֹד֙ אֶת אֱלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם כִּֽי יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֖ לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ

translation_notes: Justice commands resist crowd pressure, false reports, bribery, and bending justice either against or toward poor by partiality.
Enemy animal laws interrupt hatred with concrete help.
Sabbath year/week extends rest to poor, animals, servant's son, and sojourner; liberation becomes ecological/social rhythm.
Sojourner ethics are grounded in knowing the soul/life of the sojourner from Egypt memory.
Land/displacement language is ethically difficult and requires later audit; preserve source wording without using it to justify modern dispossession.
safety_note: Do not use Exodus 23 land language to justify modern ethnic cleansing, colonialism, or religious violence. Covenant faithfulness, justice, sojourner protection, rest, and anti-idolatry must govern interpretation, with conquest/displacement texts flagged for careful ethical audit.
